verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community report of supporting a Win10 machine from Linux with AnyDesk, which implies a Linux viewer can control a Windows host. Docs reference Windows-specific CLI pages but never list supported platforms, and a 2014 launch thread said the Mac version was missing. missing for 10: first-party documentation of supported desktop OSes (macOS, Linux, Windows), any evidence of mobile clients (iOS/Android), explicit documentation of cross-OS host/viewer sessions, current independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: A user doing occasional remote support for a club's Win10 machine from Linux moved from LogMeIn to TeamViewer (which also got breached) to AnyDesk.
[CLI Connection commands](/v1/docs/command-line-interface-for-windows#connection-commands) can also be used to modify desktop shortcuts created by AnyDesk.
